summary_zh:
這是斯奈山半島最重要的景點，山頂形狀就像草帽，也像教堂，因而稱作「教會山」或是「草帽山」

前方有個「教會山瀑布」

2025 年這裡新建了觀景步道，更方便行走。
summary_en: Kirkjufell, the most iconic landmark on the Snæfellsnes Peninsula, looks like a hat or a church, giving it the nicknames “Church Mountain” and “Hat Mountain.” A waterfall, Kirkjufell Waterfall, lies just ahead. In 2025 a new viewing trail was opened, making the hike easier. There is a paid parking lot nearby, but no restroom facilities. Plan to spend about an hour exploring the area and enjoy the panoramic views from the lookout.
